events.speaker: user
events.text: Hi, is this, uh, Dennis Halloway?

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Yeah, speaking. Who's this?

events.speaker: user
events.text: Hey Dennis, it's Jake from The Herakles. Just so you know, uh, I've got an AI assistant that analyses the call, kind of helps me take notes. That okay?

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Uh... sure, I guess. What's this about?

events.speaker: user
events.text: Great, great. So, we're a digital studio and we build custom business software, like, tools made for your agency specifically, so instead of juggling spreadsheets and, and five different apps, you get one system that tracks your listings, your leads, your showings, your follow-ups, all of it, and the cool part is—

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Okay, hang on, hang on. I've got a showing in, like, twenty minutes. I really can't do a whole pitch right now.

events.speaker: user
events.text: Totally, totally fair. Sorry. Just, uh, one quick question then?

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: ...Go ahead.

events.speaker: user
events.text: How are you guys keeping track of leads right now?

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Honestly? Um, a shared spreadsheet and a CRM we kind of, kind of half use. Leads come in from the website, from email, from the portals, and somebody's supposed to copy them over, and... yeah. My agents hate it.

events.speaker: user
events.text: Mm-hmm.

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Why, what would you even do differently?

events.speaker: user
events.text: So, uh, we'd sit down with your team, see how they actually work, and build around that. Like, a lead comes in from your website, it gets assigned to an agent automatically, the agent gets a text, and you see the whole pipeline on one screen. No copying anything.

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Huh. Okay, that's... that's actually the exact thing I complain about every Monday.

events.speaker: user
events.text: Right, yeah, we hear that a lot from agencies.

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: But, uh, custom software, that sounds pricey. We're twelve people. I'm not exactly sitting on some big tech budget here.

events.speaker: user
events.text: Yeah, no, I get it. So we usually start small, like a first version with just the lead piece, and it's priced more like, um, a few months of what you're probably paying for that CRM nobody uses.

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Wait, really? Okay. And it would, uh, talk to our website? And the portals?

events.speaker: user
events.text: Yep, yep. Website, email, and the listing portals too, as long as they've got some kind of export.

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Okay, now I'm curious. Tell you what, just shoot me an email with some examples and I'll look at it tonight.

events.speaker: user
events.text: I can definitely do that. But, um, honestly, examples won't mean much without seeing your setup. Could we do a quick twenty-minute video call? I'd show you a demo we built for an agency, like, pretty much your size.

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Hmm... Yeah. Yeah, okay, you're right, a PDF's not gonna sell me. What about Thursday morning?

events.speaker: user
events.text: Thursday works! Ten o'clock?

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Ten's great. And bring that lead routing thing, I wanna show my office manager. She's gonna love it, she's the one copying everything.

events.speaker: user
events.text: Perfect. I'll send an invite to, uh, what's the best email for you?

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Just use the contact one on our website, it comes straight to me.

events.speaker: user
events.text: Got it. Thanks, Dennis, and good luck with the showing!

events.speaker: prospect
events.text: Thanks, Jake. See you Thursday.
